managed_settings.lora: Only rank is configurable in the pinned SDK. Historical r64 run used alpha32 and included lm_head; backend settings must be audited for each new run.
managed_settings.mtp_training: Not exposed by the SDK; no on/off assertion is made.
managed_settings.hardware_parallelism: Managed by Baseten; GPU count and placement are not client-side recipe settings.
managed_settings.optimizer_precision: Managed by Baseten; not overridden by this recipe.
managed_settings.image_pixels: Audited local Nemotron grid; float bicubic resize quantized to uint8 PNG. Server processor identity is unverified.
managed_settings.masking: Assistant receipt parse plus turn terminator only; prompt, images and template-injected thinking prefix masked.
managed_settings.validation: Official separate 100-row validation split, each row exactly once; test split never used by training.
managed_settings.sample_order: Client seed42 shuffle at each epoch boundary.
managed_settings.context: 8K retains complete image/text answers; historical training maximum4197 tokens.
managed_settings.truncation: Fail before allocation on overlong rows; never truncate or drop an example.
